quarterly_data.quarter: Accelink press release: Accelink at ECOC 2026: Charting the New Future of Optical (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: At ECOC 2026 (Malaga, September 21 to 23; booth #1007) Accelink showcased three items: the 12.8T XPO liquid-cooled pluggable optical module, which the company says it publicly demonstrated for the first time, running live on an on-site liquid-cooling platform with all 64x200G channels tested in real time and BER results displayed (a demonstration); 400G/Lane rate technology, which the release calls a key technical node for next-generation 3.2T pluggable optical modules (exhibited); and a 6.4T NPO (near-packaged optics) solution (showcased; the release says it is expected to ease traditional optical-interconnect bottlenecks). The company says it keeps increasing R&D investment in silicon photonics engines, advanced packaging and high-density optical design. No customers, orders, volumes or availability dates stated.
quarterly_data.figure: 12.8T XPO live demo (64x200G); 400G/Lane toward 3.2T modules; 6.4T NPO; exhibits only, no shipment stated
